author: tvami
body:
Adds `TTbar_14TeV_TuneCP5_2025.h5` (100 events, 400 kB), the input of the new relval
workflow 16834.86: the 2025 TTbar workflow with GEN-SIM replaced by SIM read from a
GenHDF5 file (`GeneratorInterface/GenHDF5Interface`, cmssw branch tvami:genhdf5-reader).

The file holds the same GEN events as 16834.0 step 1 (relval seeds, single thread),
written with https://gitlab.cern.ch/tvami/genhdf5. Read via
`customise.simFromHDF5RelVal` as `IOMC/Input/data/TTbar_14TeV_TuneCP5_2025.h5`.
title: Add GenHDF5 relval input
